Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class AuditStore

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.AuditStore
public class AuditStore extends Object
Append-only record of admin actions (SRS UC-3.3 S1, UC-3.7). Entries can be added and read, never edited or removed, so the history stays a faithful record of what was done. Each entry is saved to the audit_log table as it is appended; load() rebuilds them.
